author: Unity
description:
The official Unity plugin for Claude Code changes how you build in Unity from the terminal.

In this video, we’ll walk you through how to install the Unity plugin in Claude Code, explore the pipeline architecture, and show it in action with a real Unity project.

Whether you’re building XR experiences, prototyping gameplay, or managing complex scenes, the Unity CLI plugin lets Claude Code read and interact with the Unity Editor directly at runtime, so you spend less time switching contexts, and more time creating.

🔗 Get started: https://on.unity.com/ClaudePlugin
